interpretation: Five shuffled paired process samples; operation-only CPU/wall with build recorded separately. Each workload checks full input/output/final-state hashes across all fifteen processes. The independent selector oracle exercises every occurrence at word0/final-word/prefix boundaries, long empty-word runs, uniform/missing values, set/move/insert/erase, native AVX2 and scalar ASan+UBSan. AtCoder speed unmeasured.
